subtitle: A Blue Flag swimming beach in Toronto's outer harbour better known to locals by a euphemism for alleged decades of police violence.
spike_statement: The beach's nickname, Cherry Beach Express — also a 1984 song Toronto Police tried to ban — commemorates alleged police brutality from the 1940s to 1990s.

levers.photo_tone: Flat gray Lake Ontario light over a narrow industrial-edge beach, cottonwoods and soccer-field floodlights at the tree line; matter-of-fact, not scenic.
